purpose: paired symmetry and relation-strategy ablations; correctness and collection screening, not total-runtime selection
identity_gate: before discovery seal full CurveSpecs, EC1/ICV1 identities, archive manifests, native control point/column/coefficient maps, public targets, runner source revision and binary hashes together with both protocol hashes

ablations.name: negation
ablations.match: identical archive manifest, point order, oracle and target

ablations.name: frobenius_columns
ablations.only_if: certified Koblitz instance and signed-orbit-closed archive
ablations.match: identical archive manifest, point order, oracle and target

ablations.name: cubic_columns
ablations.match: identical archive manifest, point order, oracle and target

ablations.name: quartic_columns
ablations.match: identical archive manifest, point order, oracle and target

ablations.name: frobenius_pair_table
ablations.only_if: certified Koblitz instance and signed-orbit-closed archive
ablations.match: identical archive, quotient columns and target

ablations.name: large_prime_residuals
ablations.only_if: certified Koblitz instance, signed-orbit-closed archive and a unit point in each column
ablations.match: identical archive, quotient columns, target and residual-domain construction; 0 is the direct control

ablations.name: torsion_coordinate_control
ablations.only_if: both exact native bases construct on the imported Koblitz instance
ablations.match: same curve, divisor, public target and oracle; record the different exact point sets and column counts; descriptive only

rank_rule: only fully eliminated group-valid equations count; rank_fraction=rank/(columns+1); raw rank/yield across different column counts is descriptive, never a standalone win

resources.cell_order: freeze lexicographic curve identity, manifest hash, ablation name, workload seed and variant order before discovery; A/B order alternates by workload seed parity

selection.discovery_rule: complete valid pairs only; increasing aggregate trials-to-full-rank ratio then manifest SHA256; freeze finalist hashes before opening confirmation
selection.confirmation_gate: all 8 pairs complete and valid; fewer trials in at least 7 of 8; aggregate candidate/control trials <= 0.90; report as collection screening only
selection.unknown_or_censored: retain exact failure, unsupported, timeout, exhaustion or memory status; ineligible as wins

regularity_rule: inherited v1 metric only where an exact encoding exists; table symmetry or residual merging does not itself measure regularity
unsupported_extensions: GLS or other extension-field archive codecs
native subgroup scalars wider than u64
speedup_claim: requires separate paired ecbench one-public-target protocol with complete cost, matched strongest rho and independent replay
